term.label: piRNA_gene

definition.text: A gene that encodes for an piwi associated RNA.

comments: Moved from ncRNA_gene to sncRNA_gene 27 April 2021 to be more consistent with the organization of the ncRNA branch of SO. Requested by FlyBase, moved by Dave Sant. See GitHub Issue #514.
